signal: Qualia is rolling out Clear 2.0 automations through Q2 2026 and moved 118-year-old Old Republic Title onto its platform

email.body1:
Chris, saw Qualia is rolling out Clear 2.0 and just brought Old Republic Title onto the platform.

Momentum like that usually means more inbound and in-market accounts than an SDR team can follow up with fast enough, so good leads cool while reps research and write. Our AI SDR drafts and follows up autonomously, so response speed and follow-up volume scale without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up for Qualia.

Most SDR teams lose deals to slow first touches and thin personalization, not bad lists, and on a busy floor those gaps add up fast. The fix is usually a few targeted changes to how the first three touches are written, sequenced, and timed across email and LinkedIn.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound with three concrete things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Qualia.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 600 replies and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other proptech SDR teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and ramp without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A big platform rollout keeps an SDR floor plenty busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Qualia either way.
